meta.title: The empty-list message can be read in full

plan.title: PRA-EXT-002 Empty PR assignment search message

steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering configuration before entering the PR flow.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen required by the case.
Use an open PR, which is the eligible state for assignment actions.
Tick one PR item so the assignment action becomes available.
Open the PR assignee selection flow.

args.goal: In the Assign flow, type a name that matches no assignee and stop with the complete empty-list message visibly readable on screen.

steps.note: The exact search field and empty-list message are not named in the case or catalog, so operate the current buyer screen and verify the full message there.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash or unrelated error while the empty-list message is displayed.
